fills.name: Sacred Groves / Hamingja
fills.quote: The Sacred Grove increases the armor of nearby units by +1 and Berserkers are automatically recruited at the Sacred Grove.
fills.note: Grove regenerates 5 HP/s after 30 s with no enemies nearby.
fills.verdictReason: Sacred Grove descriptionEn: 'increases the armor of nearby units by +1'. The word 'Hamingja' is not on the page, but the project's own definition of this bonus is the Grove armor aura, which the page gives as +1.

fills.name: Sacred Groves / Hamingja
fills.verdictReason: Both Sacred Grove entries' descriptionEn end with 'Limited to 3 Sacred Groves.'

fills.name: Imperial population
fills.quote: Increases population and maximum population by +10.
fills.note: Kongens Dør +10, Rikets Nyckel +10, Folkekirken another +10.
fills.verdictReason: No object named 'Imperial population' is on the page. Both Age IV landmarks (Kongens Dør Cathedral, Rikets Nyckel Castle) state 'Increases population and maximum population by +10', which supports the project's '210 regardless of landmark' bonus. The quoted sentence alone is also Folkekirken's text, a separate +10 (210 to 220).

fills.verdictReason: Under the mustering section the page says: 'Chaque rassemblement n'est utilisable qu'une seule fois et prend 5 secondes à s'effectuer.' This is the 5 s muster duration, stored in the project's time field.

fills.name: Mustering
fills.quote: (vous démarrez avec une charge de rassemblement directement)
fills.verdictReason: The page says: '(vous démarrez avec une charge de rassemblement directement)'. That is one starting muster charge.

fills.name: Mustering
fills.verdictReason: Gathering Hall musters on the page cost 1350 food in both Age 3 (mangonels, gallowglass, border reivers) and Age 4 (tacksmen). Age 2 musters cost 600. Caveat: the Age 4 Three Lochs 'marine royale' muster costs 2400 food, so 1350 holds for the Gathering Hall musters only, not every Imperial Age muster.
